label: Message to omp
readOnly: Replies are off here while another omp window may have this chat open.

placeholder.working: Queue a message for when omp finishes this reply
placeholder.shell: Type a shell command to run in the project folder…

send.label: Send message
send.queueTip: Send when omp finishes this reply
send.nowTip: Send now. omp reads it at its next step, before this reply finishes.

plus.label: Add files, prompts and commands
plus.tip: Attach files, mention a file, or pick a saved prompt

attach.label: Attached images
attach.drop: Drop to add to your message
attach.dropHint: Images are attached; other files are mentioned so omp reads them.
attach.unsupported: That clipboard content can't be attached. Try PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP.

mention.header: Mention a file so omp reads it with your message
mention.label: Project files

question.hint: omp needs your answer to continue

queue.title_one: {{count}} queued. It sends when omp finishes.
queue.title_other: {{count}} queued. They send in order when omp finishes.
queue.sendNowTip: Send this now. omp reads it at its next step, before this reply finishes.
queue.reorder: Move message {{position}} of {{count}} (use arrow keys, or drag)

shell.label: Shell command mode
shell.tip: Run what you type as a terminal command in the project folder. The output appears in the chat.

python.label: Python mode
python.tip: Run what you type as Python code. The result appears in the chat.

context.label: Context used: {{percent}}%
context.title: Context window
context.body: How much of omp's context window this chat fills. When it is full, compact the chat to make room.
context.compactTip: Summarize the chat so far to free context.
context.compactBusy: Available when omp finishes the current reply.

voice.stop: Stop and insert what you said
voice.nothingBody: Check the microphone, or set up voice if this is the first time.
voice.ready: Voice input is on. Click the microphone and talk.
voice.consentBody: omp turns what you say into text in this box. You check it, then send.
voice.consentLocal: By default the speech model runs on this computer, so your voice isn't uploaded.
voice.consentDownload: The first time, omp downloads the speech model (a few hundred MB). "Set up voice" lets you pick a model and language.
voice.consentRestart: This chat restarts once so omp picks up the change. Nothing is lost.
voice.clearTuiFirst: There's an unsent message in omp's editor. Send it or clear it before dictating.

library.title: Prompt library
library.description: Reuse your saved prompts, the project's custom commands, and omp's skills.
library.savedEmptyBody: Save messages you send often and insert them with one click.
library.commandsEmptyTitle: No custom commands in this project
library.commandsEmptyBody: Add Markdown files to .omp/commands in the project and they show up here.
library.skillsEmptyBody: Skills give omp extra instructions for specific tasks. Add them from Manage → Skills.
